access_scope: The accessed date applies to every source row in this manifest.
policy: Primary sources only. Reported results belong to their authors unless RESULTS.md explicitly labels them as this repository's measurements.

sources.title: unitree_ros2
sources.used_for: Go2 ROS 2/DDS boundary and Humble-oriented integration
sources.limits: Repository documentation is an interface reference, not proof that Parcel has run on a Go2 or AGX Orin.

sources.title: unitree_mujoco
sources.used_for: First articulated Go2 simulator tier, SDK2/DDS lifecycle, terrain and command-contract tests
sources.limits: Simulated actuation and stops cannot establish a physical stopping envelope.

sources.title: unitree_rl_lab
sources.used_for: Go2 Isaac Lab training/deployment path
sources.limits: Adoption requires a pinned compatible Isaac stack and an independent Parcel safety boundary.

sources.title: unitree_rl_mjlab
sources.used_for: Go2 MuJoCo Playground training, ONNX export and deployment reference
sources.limits: A vendor-supported path still does not validate Parcel's payload, sensors, surfaces or stop path.

sources.title: Isaac Lab MDP utilities
sources.used_for: Modular observation, event, reward, termination, curriculum and randomization design
sources.limits: API availability is not a claim of integration in this repository.

sources.title: Isaac Lab reproducibility and determinism
sources.used_for: Seed policy and separation of deterministic evaluation from GPU training
sources.limits: The documentation warns that some GPU/runtime randomization paths may remain nondeterministic.

sources.title: Sim-to-Real: Learning Agile Locomotion For Quadruped Robots
sources.used_for: Actuator modelling, latency simulation, system identification and dynamics randomization
sources.limits: Results are on the authors' robot and task, not Unitree Go2 with Parcel's payload.

sources.title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots
sources.used_for: Privileged simulation training followed by online latent adaptation
sources.limits: The reported A1 transfer does not establish Go2 stairs or navigation safety.

sources.title: ArtPlanner: Robust Legged Robot Navigation in the Field
sources.used_for: Reachability abstraction, learned motion cost and negative-obstacle-aware local planning
sources.limits: Author field results and timing are design evidence, not replicated Parcel measurements.

sources.title: Legged Locomotion in Challenging Terrains using Egocentric Vision
sources.used_for: Privileged-to-egocentric perception distillation for stairs, curbs, gaps and stepping obstacles
sources.limits: Reported terrain skills do not authorize Parcel to attempt stairs.

sources.title: NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation
sources.used_for: Two-level language/spatial action generation plus real-time visual locomotion
sources.limits: Reported Go2 demonstrations are the authors' results; a VLA must not bypass Parcel's typed safety and completion authorities.

sources.title: NaVILA official implementation
sources.used_for: Implementation-readiness and dependency audit
sources.limits: Training/model/evaluation TODOs remain in the public repository; license and runtime compatibility require review before reuse.

sources.title: Constraint-Aware Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
sources.used_for: Constraint-aware subinstruction completion and structured value maps
sources.limits: Paper-reported benchmark gains are not replicated here and use a different embodiment.

sources.title: GOAT-Bench: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Lifelong Navigation
sources.used_for: Sequential category, language and image goals with explicit/implicit memory and noisy actuation
sources.limits: Benchmark embodiment and assets differ from Go2; it supplies task structure, not a physical pass.

sources.title: HM3D-OVON: A Dataset and Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation
sources.used_for: Held-out object categories and noisy open-vocabulary navigation evaluation
sources.limits: Dataset/runtime licensing and a non-Go2 embodiment limit near-term use.

sources.title: Habitat-Matterport 3D Semantics Dataset
sources.used_for: Indoor semantic scene assets and license feasibility
sources.limits: Assets have access/license conditions; repository adapter contracts are not scene-level results.

sources.title: Visual Language Maps for Robot Navigation
sources.used_for: Open-vocabulary spatial memory fused with 3D reconstruction
sources.limits: Map quality inherits reconstruction and odometry errors; it must not become independent arrival evidence.

sources.title: Hydra: A Real-time Spatial Perception System for 3D Scene Graph Construction and Optimization
sources.used_for: Incremental metric-semantic scene graphs, topology and hierarchical loop closure
sources.limits: Author platform timing is only feasibility evidence; Parcel has not integrated or benchmarked Hydra on AGX Orin.

sources.title: Hydra official implementation
sources.used_for: Implementation and embedded-platform feasibility audit
sources.limits: Repository support does not imply compatibility with Parcel's current localizer or map schema.

sources.title: Failure Prediction with Statistical Guarantees for Vision-Based Robot Control
sources.used_for: Calibrated failure prediction and selective autonomy with statistical error bounds
sources.limits: Guarantees apply under the paper's assumptions and calibration data, not automatically to Parcel.

sources.title: Certifiably-Correct Mapping for Safe Navigation Despite Odometry Drift
sources.used_for: Safe-region deflation as localization uncertainty accumulates
sources.limits: The paper's assumptions and sensor model must be validated before transferring any guarantee.

sources.title: STEP: Stochastic Traversability Evaluation and Planning for Risk-Aware Off-road Navigation
sources.used_for: Uncertainty-aware traversability, tail risk and model-predictive local planning
sources.limits: Reported underground wheeled/legged results do not validate Go2 indoor stairs.

sources.title: MetaUrban: An Embodied AI Simulation Platform for Urban Micromobility
sources.used_for: Procedural social-navigation scenes, unseen split design and morphology diversity
sources.limits: The paper's reported generalization is not a Parcel result; the repository's MetaUrban adapter is currently incomplete.

sources.title: MetaUrban official implementation
sources.used_for: Runtime, scene generation and integration feasibility
sources.limits: Requires an isolated pinned environment and a Parcel IPC adapter.

sources.title: Habitat 3.0: A Co-Habitat for Humans, Avatars and Robots
sources.used_for: Find/follow social tasks and human-distance evaluation in interactive scenes
sources.limits: Current Parcel evidence is one-step adapter contracts only; licensed assets and full runtime are absent.

sources.title: Habitat-Lab
sources.used_for: Benchmark task/configuration and evaluator integration audit
sources.limits: Pinned upstream code does not supply the required licensed scenes or establish Go2 dynamics.

sources.title: SocNavBench: A Grounded Simulation Testing Framework for Evaluating Social Navigation
sources.used_for: Real-pedestrian-data-grounded scenarios and interpretable social metrics
sources.limits: Benchmark metrics require task-specific calibration for a companion dog and its owner.

sources.title: Follow-Bench: A Unified Motion Planning Benchmark for Socially-Aware Robot Person Following
sources.used_for: Target paths, crowd flows, formations, following distances, occlusion and safe search
sources.limits: Reported benchmark findings are external; exact robot embodiment and sensor transfer remain open.

sources.title: TPT-Bench: A Large-Scale, Long-Term and Robot-Egocentric Dataset for Benchmarking Target Person Tracking
sources.used_for: Long-duration identity, disappearance, distractor and reacquisition stress tests
sources.limits: The full corpus is large; start with the evaluation subset and do not imply current integration.

sources.title: Towards Generalizable Safety in Crowd Navigation via Conformal Uncertainty Handling
sources.used_for: Adaptive conformal uncertainty for distribution-shift-aware crowd navigation
sources.limits: Coverage/safety claims require exchangeability or the method's stated adaptive assumptions and Parcel-specific calibration.

sources.title: Sim2Val: Leveraging Correlation Across Test Platforms for Variance-Reduced Metric Estimation
sources.used_for: Paired simulator/real control variates and correlation-measured validation
sources.limits: Variance reduction needs paired physical data; simulator-only scores cannot substitute for it.
